newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan tendering for 61,000T U.S. wheat - traders.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tendering for 61,000T U.S. wheat - traders.

text.p: The Taiwan Flour Mills Association will tender on Tuesday for 61,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat in two shipments, Taipei traders confirmed.

The first shipment of 35,000 tonnes would be slated for February 15 to March 5 delivery from the Pacific Northwest, with 18,100 tonnes of dark northern spring (DNS), 10,500 tonnes of hard red winter (HRW), and 6,400 tonnes of white wheat (WW).
The second shipment of 26,000 tonnes would be slated for February 28 to March 20 from the Pacific Northwest, with 17,700 tonnes of DNS and 8,300 tonnes of HRW.
